artworks.title: Charles-Maurice Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body and head of a man facing slightly to the left. He has a rounded face, soft lips, a straight nose, and calm eyes under dark, curly hair. The man wears an ecclesiastical robe with a wide collar and a cross hanging from his neck. He is framed in an oval with inscribed text and an ornate coat of arms at the bottom. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: Charles-Maurice Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man positioned at a slight angle, with his head turned slightly toward the viewer. The man has wavy, shoulder-length hair that frames his face. His facial features include a prominent nose, defined cheekbones, and a gentle expression. He is wearing a dark robe with a wide, white collar. The robe has a loose fit and is detailed with a tassel. The portrait is surrounded by an ornate, octagonal frame, and below it, there is a coat of arms featuring a crown and design elements like stars and a shield. The background consists of fine, textured lines.

artworks.title: Charles-Maurice Le Tellier
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a man. The man is depicted from the upper body up, with his head turned slightly to the right. He has delicate facial features, including a long nose and a small mouth, and is gazing towards the viewer with a calm expression. His hair is medium length, dark, and falls in gentle waves just above his collar. He is wearing a dark cassock and white clerical collar. The background is plain, and the portrait is contained within an ornate oval frame with inscriptions at the top that read "MAURITIUS LE TELLIER ABBAS ET COMES LANCISIENSIS" and bears a coat of arms at the bottom.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man with his body depicted from the chest up. He is positioned facing the viewer, with his head slightly turned to the side. The man has curly, medium-length hair that frames his face and a neatly groomed goatee. His expression is calm and composed. He is wearing attire that includes a white, square collar over a dark garment. Adorning his clothing are two ornate insignias shaped like stars. The background consists of a textured, oval frame that encloses the portrait. The name "Michael le Tellier" is inscribed below the portrait.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man in an oval frame. He is seated, facing slightly to the right with a faint smile, shoulder-length wavy hair, a mustache, and a beard. The man wears a dark robe with a white collar and a large star on his chest. The frame is decorated with cherubs holding objects, a snake below, garlands, Latin text, and stars above, and pilasters in the background. The setting resembles a classical style with wood paneling or columns.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bust-length portrait. The man is positioned three-quarters to the viewer's right, looking towards the viewer with a slight smile. He has a long, slightly pointed nose, a groomed mustache and beard, wavy shoulder-length hair parted down the middle, and is wearing 17th-century clothing with a high-collared shirt and a dark vest or robe with an elaborate collar. The portrait is encased in an oval frame with a Latin inscription around it and a below emblem resembling a coat of arms. The background within the oval frame is a simple texture, contrasting with the detailed depiction of the man, while the outer areas contain a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body portrait. He is looking directly at the viewer with a composed expression. The man has wavy, shoulder-length hair, a neatly trimmed mustache, and goatee. He wears formal attire with a dark robe, white collar, and a sash with a star-shaped emblem on his left shoulder. There is a coat of arms below the portrait. The background includes an oval frame with an inscription and a detailed textured pattern. The engraving is monochromatic with intricate lines and shading.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated, turned slightly to the side, and looking at the viewer. The man has distinct facial features, a pointed beard, a mustache, and wavy, medium-length hair. He is wearing historical attire, including a buttoned vest with intricate detailing, a high, broad white collar, and a star emblem on his shoulder. He is framed within an ornate, oak leaf border, and the background has engraved lines suggesting texture or shadow.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image features a detailed portrait of a person from the chest up. The individual faces slightly to the right with a gentle expression. They have a slight mustache and medium-length wavy hair. The person wears period clothing with an ornate collar and a garment adorned with an emblem. An ornamental ribbon drapes over their chest. The oval frame surrounding them is intricately designed with botanical motifs, possibly laurel leaves. The background includes two crowns, the letters "IV," and decorative foliage. Below the portrait is a heraldic shield with three charges.

artworks.title: Francois Servien
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is slightly turned to his right, looking directly at the viewer. The man has distinct features, including a narrow mustache and a small beard. His dark hair is styled with gentle waves, reaching ear length. He is wearing clerical clothing with a robe and a large white collar. A cross pendant hangs around his neck. The background has detailed engravings, and he is framed by ornate, textured borders resembling leaves. At the bottom, there is a coat of arms for added distinction.

artworks.title: Chancellor Pierre Seguier
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Charles Le Brun
artworks.description: The image displays an engraved portrait of a man depicted from the chest up within an oval border. The man has long, curly hair, a mustache, and a tufted goatee. His facial expression is neutral, and he is dressed in formal attire with a wide-collared white ruff and a dark, textured outer garment. There is an insignia on his chest and several decorative elements surrounding the portrait. Engraved letters encircle the portrait, and a coat of arms is featured at the bottom within the frame. The background consists of closely spaced vertical lines.

artworks.title: Georges de Scudery
artworks.description: The image displays a half-length portrait of a man in an oval frame. He faces slightly to the right with his body turned towards the viewer, and his head is turned slightly to the left, looking straight ahead. He has long, wavy hair, a prominent nose, thin lips, and deep-set eyes. The man wears a dark buttoned garment with a white collar and a visible shirt sleeve on his right side. The oval frame is set against a backdrop resembling bricks or a masonry pattern, with no visible jewelry or objects. Below the portrait is a text inscription within a decorative rectangular space.

artworks.title: Georges de Scudery
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man in a seated position within an oval frame. The man is facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair and a mustache, with facial features that include a prominent nose. The man is dressed in a buttoned, dark-colored coat with a white collar that features lace detailing, and he has a garment draped over his left shoulder. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The oval portrait is set against a faux brick-patterned background that also frames the portrait on either side. Beneath the image is a plaque with engraved text detailing the man's name, title, and accomplishments.

artworks.title: Marie-Jeanne-Baptiste, Duchesse de Savoie
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a woman's upper torso, including her head and shoulders. She is facing slightly left but looking directly at the viewer. The woman has a round face and a serene expression, with full lips and wide eyes framed by her hair styled in tight curls. She wears an elaborate dress with lace at the neckline and intricate embroidery. A pearl necklace and drop earring adorn her. The woman is encased in an ornate frame with garlands and a crest featuring a crown and coat of arms. The background is intricately designed.

artworks.title: Charles-Emmanuel, Duc de Savoie
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Justus van Verus
artworks.description: The image shows a waist-up portrait of a man within a decorative frame. The man has long curly hair, a calm expression, and is wearing regal attire. The frame features elaborate carvings and crests, including cherubs, draped figures, helmets, and a coat of arms. The background includes Roman soldier busts holding shields, and a Latin inscription on a plinth below the portrait.

artworks.title: Jean-Pierre Sarrazin
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He is facing forward with a slight turn to his right. He has long, wavy hair that falls just below his shoulders. His facial features include a mustache and a closed-lip smile, with prominent eyes and a smooth complexion. He is wearing a wide-collared garment with a detailed tie or brooch at the neck, and a draped fabric over his shoulders. The background consists of a detailed engraved oval frame with inscriptions, and below the portrait, there is a panel with text, all set against a lined backdrop.

artworks.title: Charles-Paris d'Orléans-Longueville, Comte de Saint-Pol
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a portrait, positioned in a three-quarter view facing right with long, wavy hair and a gentle facial expression. They wear an ornate robe with a white collar and a chain with a cross pendant around their neck. The background includes an oval frame with text along the inner border, and below the portrait is a crest with three fleur-de-lis and a crown. The artwork is detailed and engraved.

artworks.title: Cardinal Richelieu
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in a half-length view. He is seated facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a pointed mustache, a short goatee, medium-length hair combed back, and is dressed in formal attire including a garment with a wide, white collar. He wears a pendant with a star emblem around his neck. The portrait is framed by an ornate border of foliage, and the background is dark, contrasting with the lighter tones of his attire and the frame.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Retz
artworks.description: It is a portrait of a man facing slightly left. He has a slightly rounded face, pronounced eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a small mustache. He has wavy, mid-length hair and is wearing a clerical robe with an embellished pattern and high collar. Around his neck is a chain with a large cross pendant. The background is a simple, lightly patterned surface.

artworks.title: Claude Regnauldin
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man's upper body. He is seated facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the left. The man has a slender face with a high forehead and defined cheekbones, along with a pointy beard and mustache that are mostly gray. His wavy hair matches his facial hair, extending to his collar. He is wearing an ecclesiastical outfit with a buttoned vest under a robe and a white clerical collar. He also wears a cap typical of clerical attire. The portrait is set within an oval frame with a crest at the base featuring a tree emblem. The background inside the oval is textured, while the outer area contains Latin inscriptions encircling the frame.

artworks.title: Pierre Poncet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man with a bust view. He is facing the viewer with his body slightly angled to the right. The man has a high forehead, prominent cheekbones, and a subtle smile. He has medium-length wavy hair that falls to his shoulders. He is wearing a dark robe with an intricately detailed buttoned vest, a wide white collar, and no visible jewelry. The background is plain with ornate framing elements, including a coat of arms and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Pierre Poncet
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man facing slightly to his right, looking at the viewer. He has distinct facial features including a prominent nose and high cheekbones, wavy shoulder-length hair, and is dressed in traditional academic or clerical attire. The portrait is encased within an oval frame with Latin text around it and a coat of arms below featuring a fleur-de-lis and star. The background outside the oval frame is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: Simon Arnauld, Le Marquis de Pomponne
artworks.description: The portrait depicts the upper body of a person, focusing on the head and shoulders. The person is looking directly at the viewer with distinct facial features including a long, narrow nose, prominent lips, and slightly arched eyebrows. The subject's hair is long and curly, falling around the face and shoulders in voluminous waves. He is wearing elaborate clothing with a richly patterned fabric and a high lace collar. The background of the image is plain with an oval frame encircling the portrait, with inscribed text in Latin.

artworks.title: Louis-Marie, Queen of Poland
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Justus van Verus
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman depicted from the waist up. She is positioned facing slightly to the right, with her gaze directed towards the viewer. Her facial features include a rounded face, soft expression, and a small closed smile, with curly and voluminous hair styled elegantly, parted in the middle and decorated with a simple pearl earring dangling from her visible ear. She is adorned in a luxurious garment that drapes around her shoulders, featuring bows and layers that suggest opulence and sophistication. A single strand pearl necklace accentuates her neckline. The background is a finely detailed oval frame surrounding the portrait, set against a darker shaded area, featuring inscriptions within the inner circular border and additional text below.
